text.description_html:
Michael Healy MH1011, Large Dragonfly Door Knocker in Brass and Bronze

The Large Polished Brass Dragonfly Door Knocker is a huge 8-1/2 inches wide and 6-1/2 inches tall, making it a great statement piece for even the largest of front doors. This sandcast brass Dragonfly in Flight Door Knocker is finished in polished brass and satin bronze. It comes packaged with all the necessary mounting hardware to surface mount it on a wood or metal door.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Available in 3 finishes:
Polished Brass and Bronze Nickel Silver Oiled Bronze

Features and Specifications of the Dragonfly Front Door Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish: Polished Brass and Bronze
  • Height: 6-1/2
  • Width: 8-1/2"
  • Mounting Hole Centers: 7/8"
  • Projection Off Door: 1-3/4"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
